Gate 1
Does a film model measured over black and white backgrounds predict on-skin whitening better than the label's zinc percentage? (PLOS ONE 2025 raw data, 13 volunteers, held out by person and by formulation)
FAIL film model 4.79 L* mean error vs label model 1.61. Exploratory only: on the one differently formulated product, a one-parameter film model missed by 0.69 L* vs the label's 2.35. gate1-results.md (opens in a new tab)
K2
Is YouCam's skin tone analysis a usable measurement of the colour in a photo?
FAIL 2 of 3: identical result on a fresh upload (pass), but it moved only 0.15x as much as the measured cheek when the photo was made 10 percent brighter, and it sits 15.1 dE00 from the measured cheek. Reading, not pre-registered: it reports a lighting-normalized tone. k2-results.md (opens in a new tab)
K1
Can YouCam Makeup VTO render a sunscreen-like film, with coverage as the dose?
FAIL on 4 of 5: L* reversals at coverage 60 in 3 of 6 series, max dL* 12.7 < 15, inverse dE00 2.03 > 2.0, texture 0.556 < 0.80; R^2 0.954 passed. Post hoc reading (not pre-registered): colorIntensity, not coverage, acted as the dose. k1-results.md (opens in a new tab)
